result.topic_en: A partly struck-through German note on simpler series whose coefficient ratios are entire functions of first degree in the index (related to hypergeometric series), followed by pencil calculations of an integral involving $(1-e^{\varphi i}/r)^{1/2}(1-e^{-\varphi i}/r)^{1/2} r^m$ and trigonometric expansions.
